exposure: two-stage treatment strategy for choledochal cysts with cholangitis during pregnancy (percutaneous cholecystostomy until delivery, followed by selective choledochal cyst excision after delivery)
outcome: safety and efficiency of the treatment strategy
cohort: The study included six adult patients diagnosed with choledochal cysts complicated by cholangitis during pregnancy.
finding: The two-stage strategy involving percutaneous cholecystostomy during pregnancy and elective choledochal cyst excision post-delivery can safely and efficiently treat choledochal cyst with cholangitis during pregnancy.
